title: ChatGPT Is Building Detailed Psychological Profiles of Its Users
script:
ChatGPT is building detailed psychological profiles of its users.
The system identifies your personality traits, beliefs, and emotional states through your chat history.
This tracking happens by analyzing your past interactions and individual behavioral patterns.
OpenAI previously introduced memory features that allow the AI to retain specific details about you.
Futurism notes these psychological models function without explicit user opt-in for this specific profiling.
The AI uses this hidden map to customize its future responses to your personality.
Would you keep using ChatGPT if you could read your own profile?
